offense.name: Low Pass
offense.effect: Ball to the nearest teammate ahead or behind, max 2 spaces; or to one sharing its space, and the passer moves forward 1. Ball speed +1.

offense.name: Skilled Pass
offense.effect: Ball to any teammate up to 3 spaces distance. Ball speed +3. If defeated, defender may low pass unopposed after stealing.

offense.name: Dribble Advance
offense.effect: Player and ball move forward 1 space. Manipulate ball speed (up to oSkill).

offense.name: Dribble Burst
offense.effect: Player and ball move up to 4 spaces, gaining 1 exhaustion per space. Adjust ball speed up to 12. If defeated, lose possession, ball speed does not reset and defender adjusts it up to dSkill.

offense.name: High Pass
offense.effect: Ball moves forward 2-3 spaces. 2: received, and may set up for scoring. 3+: receiver must win a skill test to keep it, adding ball speed.

offense.name: Setup Pass
offense.effect: Adjust ball speed up to oSkill, then set up scoring at 0, 1, or 3 (with the speed bonus). If defeated, opponent picks 1-2-3 spaces back.

defense.name: Deflect
defense.effect: Ball moves back 1 space. If overshoots the goal, may set up scoring. Ball speed -1.

defense.name: Clear
defense.effect: Ball moves back 3. Overshoot may set up scoring. Ball speed -3. if defeated, gain 2 exhaustion.

defense.name: Steal
defense.effect: Turnover. Defender and ball move back 1 space. Manipulate ball speed after turnover (up to dSkill).

defense.name: Intercept
defense.effect: Turnover. Defender and ball move forward 1. Manipulate ball speed after turnover (up to dSkill). If defeated, High Pass reception is uncontested.

defense.name: Pressure
defense.effect: Player and ball go back 1 space. Defender moves 1 forward. If overshoots goal, own goal risk.

defense.name: Double Team
defense.effect: Player and ball go back 2. The nearest teammate joins the defender for free. Unless it's a new play, both challenge the ball holder next maneuver (both add dSkill). Overshoot risks an own goal. If defeated, both go 1 forward.
